title: Feature Clips Get the News Digest's Motion Graphics | vitalii.no
description:
Why two render pipelines for the same content factory meant one looked cinematic and the other looked like a static screenshot with a voiceover.

Nightly feature-demo clips were visually flat: the product screen just sat there while narration played, with none of the cinematic motion graphics — title cards, counters, quote callouts — that the daily video digest already used for news segments. Two separate pipelines, one plain and one dynamic, built out of the same factory.

The fix mirrors the digest's own motion system onto the feature-clip factory. The batch instructions now have the agent plan one catalog effect per voice beat into a shots file before rendering, gated by a dedicated check in the factory pipeline. On the render side, the shared grammar module gained a stage context so effects know the feature-clip's size and block length, plus new primitives: a motion insert that renders one effect per beat, a backdrop that keeps the real product visible as evidence underneath, and arrival transitions with a hard cut and no exit fade. A new tracking column records which effects each clip used, so the factory picks fresh ones and avoids repeating the same graphic across consecutive clips — the same variety logic the digest already had.

One engineering investment, built via Remotion, now serves two products instead of one: the feature-clip factory inherited the digest's full motion-graphics language without a second pipeline.
